headline: OJK Again Exposes Stock Manipulation, Demands Rp23.7 M Be Returned
summary: The OJK disclosed 10 capital market violations with total illegal gains of Rp23.77 billion and has ordered Rp23.7 million to be returned in one case.
why: The OJK regulates Indonesia's capital markets, and enforcement against manipulation affects investor confidence in the Jakarta Stock Exchange.
original_headline: OJK Bongkar Lagi Manipulasi Saham, Minta Rp23,7 M Dikembalikan
